section.content: 本发明公开了一种生物基因检测探针，包括壳体、设置在壳体内壁上的限位环和基座；基座顶部设置有锥形槽，锥形槽的槽壁上设置有若干基因探针，壳体内设置有可转动的加液管，加液管的底部设置有分液头，分液头的两侧对称设置有分液管，每个分液管上活动套接有用于涂抹基因探针的涂覆筒。本发明通过设置可转动的加液管、分液头和分液管，加液管转动时可带动套接在分液管上的涂覆筒转动，涂覆筒上开设有出液孔，当样本溶液流经出液孔时，样本溶液可通过出液孔排出涂覆筒并随着涂覆筒的滚动均匀的涂抹在基因探针上，避免涂覆不均导致的检测信息不全的情况出现。

The invention discloses a biological gene detection probe, which comprises a shell, a limiting ring and a base, wherein the limiting ring and the base are arranged on the inner wall of the shell; the base top is provided with the bell jar, is provided with a plurality of gene probes on the cell wall of bell jar, is provided with rotatable liquid feeding pipe in the casing, and the bottom of liquid feeding pipe is provided with the branch liquid head, and the bilateral symmetry of branch liquid head is provided with and divides the liquid pipe, and the activity is cup jointed on every branch liquid pipe and is used for scribbling the coating section of thick bamboo of gene probe. According to the invention, the rotatable liquid feeding pipe, the liquid separating head and the liquid separating pipe are arranged, the liquid feeding pipe can drive the coating cylinder sleeved on the liquid separating pipe to rotate when rotating, the coating cylinder is provided with the liquid outlet hole, and when a sample solution flows through the liquid outlet hole, the sample solution can be discharged out of the coating cylinder through the liquid outlet hole and is uniformly coated on the gene probe along with the rolling of the coating cylinder, so that the condition of incomplete detection information caused by nonuniform coating is avoided.

Biological gene detection probeTechnical Field

The invention relates to a biological gene detection probe, and belongs to the technical field of gene detection.

Background

The current common gene detection technology is to combine molecular hybridization with a target gene to generate a hybridization signal, so that the target gene in a genome is displayed, and then needed gene information is judged.

When the existing gene probe is matched with a sample solution, the sample solution cannot be ensured to be completely contacted with all the gene probes, part of the gene probes are easy to miss, the detection result is inaccurate or part of information is lost, and meanwhile, the sample solution consumed by the existing coating mode is more.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention provides a biological gene detection probe, which aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, a sample solution is not uniformly smeared, and a part of gene probes are easy to miss and leak, so that the detection result is inaccurate.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention adopts the technical scheme that:

a biological gene detection probe comprises a shell, a limiting ring and a base, wherein the limiting ring is arranged on the inner wall of the shell; the base top is provided with the bell-shaped groove, be provided with a plurality of gene probes on the cell wall of bell-shaped groove, be provided with rotatable liquid feeding pipe in the casing, the bottom of liquid feeding pipe is provided with and divides the liquid head, the bilateral symmetry that divides the liquid head is provided with and divides the liquid pipe, every divides the liquid pipe to go up the activity and cup joints the coating section of thick bamboo that is used for paining the gene probe, be provided with helical blade between the inner tube wall of a coating section of thick bamboo and the branch liquid pipe, helical blade's promotion direction is for dividing the liquid head towards, a plurality of liquid hole has been seted up to the part that the coating section of thick bamboo is in between the adjacent two rings of helical blade.

Preferably, the liquid outlet holes are spirally distributed, the screw pitch of the liquid outlet holes is the same as that of the helical blades, and the liquid outlet holes are close to one side, far away from the liquid separation head, of the helical blades.

Preferably, the outer wall of the liquid feeding pipe is provided with a spiral driving blade, a one-way driving mechanism matched with the spiral driving blade is arranged in the shell, and the one-way driving mechanism can drive the liquid feeding pipe to rotate in one way.

Preferably, the one-way driving mechanism comprises two driving sheets which can be matched, a separating and combining mechanism for controlling the mutual collision or separation of the two driving sheets and a pressing rebounding mechanism for controlling the axial movement of the two driving sheets along the liquid feeding pipe, and only when the two driving sheets are mutually collided, the two driving blades can drive the spiral driving blade to rotate along the axial movement of the liquid feeding pipe.

Preferably, press the resilience mechanism include with shells inner wall fixed connection's support, fixed mounting on the support and with the guide post that the liquid feeding pipe is parallel, slidable mounting loading board and the spring of setting between loading board and support on the guide post, seted up on the loading board with liquid feeding pipe complex through-hole, seted up logical groove on the loading board of through-hole both sides, the activity of logical inslot is pegged graft and is had spacing post, the top of spacing post is provided with presses the clamp plate.

Preferably, the dividing and combining mechanism comprises a first wedge block symmetrically arranged on the bearing plates on two sides of the through hole, a second wedge block with two ends respectively fixedly connected with the two pressing plates, a second wedge block symmetrically and slidably mounted on the cross rods on two sides of the through hole, and a second spring sleeved on the cross rod between the second wedge block, the second wedge block is matched with the first wedge block, and when the second wedge block moves towards the first wedge block, the second wedge block is close to the first wedge block.

Preferably, the two driving plates are respectively arranged on one opposite side of the two wedge blocks.

Preferably, the center of the base is provided with a drain hole.

Preferably, the bottom of the liquid separation head is provided with a plurality of spirally radial liquid stirring grooves, and when the liquid adding pipe rotates, the liquid stirring grooves can stir the sample solution into the liquid discharging hole.

Preferably, the limiting ring is provided with a friction ring surface matched with the coating cylinder.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: by arranging the conical groove, the rotatable liquid adding pipe, the liquid separating head and the liquid separating pipe, the conical groove can lead the redundant sample solution coated on the gene probe to be gathered towards the center of the conical groove, thereby being convenient for recovering and coating again, reducing the use of the sample solution, the liquid adding pipe can drive the coating barrel sleeved on the liquid separating pipe to rotate when rotating, when the liquid adding pipe rotates, the sample solution is thrown into the liquid separating pipe from the liquid separating head and further thrown into the coating barrel under the action of centrifugal force, the helical blade arranged between the inner barrel wall of the coating barrel and the pipe wall of the liquid separating pipe can overcome the centrifugal force to push the sample solution sent by the liquid adding pipe from the gap between the liquid adding pipe and the coating barrel to the direction of the liquid separating head, the coating barrel is provided with a liquid outlet hole, when the sample solution flows through the liquid outlet hole, the sample solution can be discharged from the coating barrel through the liquid outlet hole and can be uniformly coated on the gene probe along with the rolling of the coating barrel, the condition of incomplete detection information caused by uneven coating is avoided; through setting up driving plate, spiral driving blade, deciliter mechanism and pressing resilient mechanism, can order about the liquid feeding pipe through the cooperation of driving plate and spiral driving blade and rotate when pressing the pressing plate, when loosening the pressing plate, the liquid feeding pipe does not rotate, and then realizes intermittent type nature drive liquid feeding pipe unidirectional rotation, paints gene probe repeatedly, makes sample solution and gene probe's abundant comprehensive contact.

Drawings

FIG. 2 is a schematic view of the present invention in partial cross-section;

FIG. 3 is a schematic view of the coating mechanism of the present invention;

FIG. 4 is an enlarged view of a portion of the dispensing head of the present invention;

In the figure: 1. the device comprises a shell, 11, a pressing groove, 12, a limiting ring, 121, a friction ring surface, 2, a liquid feeding pipe, 21, a sample feeding hopper, 22, a liquid separating head, 221, a liquid stirring groove, 23, a liquid separating pipe, 24, a coating cylinder, 241, a liquid outlet hole, 242, a spiral blade, 25, a spiral driving blade, 3, a rotating seat, 31, a support, 311, a guide column, 32, a bearing plate, 321, a through hole, 322, a first wedge block, 323, a through groove, 33, a pressing plate, 331, a limiting column, 332, a cross rod, 333, a second wedge block, 3331, a stop plate, 334, a second spring, 34, a driving plate, 35, a first spring, 4, a base, 41, a conical groove, 42, a gene probe, 43 and a liquid discharge hole.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the implementation of the present invention will be made clear and fully described below with reference to the accompanying drawings, and the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, but not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments of the present invention without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

As shown in fig. 1 to 8, the bio-gene detection probe provided by the embodiment of the present invention includes a cylindrical housing 1, a coating mechanism disposed in the housing 1, and a base 4, wherein the bottom of the housing 1 is open, a circle of limiting ring 12 is fixedly disposed on the inner wall of the housing 1, the base 4 can be inserted into the housing 1 from the bottom of the housing 1, and the upper surface of the base 4 can partially abut against the lower surface of the limiting ring 12 to achieve positioning. Tapered groove 41 has been seted up to the upper surface of base 4, the outage 43 that runs through base 4 has been seted up at the center of tapered groove 41, be provided with a plurality of gene probe 42 on the cell wall of tapered groove 41, tapered groove 41 can make and scribble unnecessary sample solution and assemble to the outage 43 at tapered groove 41 center on gene probe 42, thereby conveniently retrieve sample solution, reuse, reduce sample solution's use, coating mechanism can evenly fully scribble the sample solution that waits to detect on gene probe 42, thereby let gene probe 42 can exert a function completely, avoid the disappearance of detection information.

As shown in fig. 6, the coating mechanism includes a liquid feeding tube 2, a liquid separating head 22, a liquid separating tube 23 and a coating cylinder 24, the liquid feeding tube 2 is rotatably fitted with the housing 1, the housing 1 is provided with a rotating base 3, the liquid feeding tube 2 is rotatably mounted on the rotating base 3, the top of the liquid feeding tube 2 is provided with a sample adding hopper 21, the liquid separating head 22 is located at the bottom of the liquid feeding tube 2 and abuts against the center of the bottom of the conical groove 41, the liquid separating tube 23 is symmetrically arranged at two sides of the liquid separating head 22, the coating cylinder 24 is movably sleeved on the liquid separating tube 23, the limiting ring 12 is provided with a friction ring surface 121 matched with the coating cylinder 24, the coating cylinder 24 can rotate relative to the liquid separating tube 23, and thus when the liquid separating tube 23 rotates, the coating cylinder 24 rubs against the friction ring surface 121 and rotates relative to the liquid separating tube 23. In order to ensure structural strength, the filling tube 2 and the liquid separation head 22 are preferably made of metal. The top of the liquid adding tube 2 extends out of the shell 1 and is provided with a sample adding hopper 21, the inner cavities of the liquid adding tube 2, the liquid separating head 22 and the liquid separating tube 23 are communicated, and after sample solution is poured into the liquid adding tube 2 from the sample adding hopper 21, the sample solution can be temporarily retained in the liquid separating head 22. In order to ensure that the surface of the coating cylinder 24 is adhered to the gene probe 42, the inclination angles of the coating cylinder 24 and the liquid distribution pipe 23 are matched with the taper of the tapered groove 41. When the coating solution is needed, the liquid adding pipe 2 can be rotated, the sample solution is thrown into the liquid separating pipe 23 from the liquid separating head 22 and further thrown into the coating cylinder 24 under the action of centrifugal force, meanwhile, the coating cylinder 24 can be rotated, a spiral blade 242 is arranged between the inner cylinder wall of the coating cylinder 24 and the pipe wall of the liquid separating pipe 23, and the spiral blade 242 and the coating cylinder 24 are integrated.

Moreover, a plurality of liquid outlet holes 241 are formed in the wall of the coating barrel 24 between two adjacent circles of the spiral blades 242, the liquid outlet holes 241 are distributed spirally, the pitch of the liquid outlet holes is the same as that of the spiral blades 242, and the liquid outlet holes 241 are close to one side of the spiral blades 242 far away from the liquid separation head 22. When the coating cylinder 24 rotates, the spiral blade 242 rotates relative to the liquid separation tube 23, so that the sample solution fed from the liquid feeding tube 2 can be pushed from the gap between the liquid feeding tube 2 and the coating cylinder 24 toward the liquid separation head 22 against the centrifugal force, when the sample solution flows through the liquid outlet 241, the sample solution can be discharged out of the coating cylinder 24 through the liquid outlet 241, and when the coating cylinder 24 rotates, the surface of the coating cylinder 24 rolls on the gene probe 42, so that the sample solution can be coated on the gene probe 42. The aperture that goes out liquid hole 241 is less, just discharge completely after just so sample solution can flow through a plurality of liquid holes 241, thereby guarantee that sample solution can cover a coating section of thick bamboo 24 and gene probe 42 complex surface, the line that goes out liquid hole 241 is the heliciform and cooperatees with helical blade 242's spiral, set up one side of keeping away from liquid distribution head 22 near helical blade 242 in a liquid hole 241, when coating section of thick bamboo 24 stall like this, sample solution between two adjacent circles helical blade 242 can be abundant discharge from going out liquid hole 241, thereby avoid remaining.

Through the arrangement, the invention can ensure the sufficient contact coating of the sample solution and the gene probe 42; furthermore, a liquid discharge hole 43 penetrating through the base 4 can be formed in the center of the tapered groove 41, and after the sample solution discharged from the liquid discharge hole 241 is coated on the gene probe 42, a part of the sample solution flows to the liquid discharge hole 43, and the part of the sample solution can be collected from the liquid discharge hole 43 and then added from the sample adding hopper 21, so that the sample solution is fully utilized, the amount of the sample solution required by detection is reduced, and the material consumption is saved.

As shown in fig. 3 to 5, a plurality of spiral radial liquid stirring grooves 221 may be formed at the bottom of the liquid separation head 22, so that when the liquid feeding pipe 2 rotates, the liquid separation head 22 rotates along with the liquid feeding pipe 2, so that the liquid stirring grooves 221 scrape the sample solution flowing to the liquid discharging hole 43, and by setting the spiral direction matching with the direction of the liquid feeding pipe 2, the liquid stirring grooves 221 may stir the sample solution, so that the sample solution is accelerated to flow to the liquid discharging hole 43, thereby promoting the discharge of the sample solution.

In order to match the use of the helical blade 242 and the liquid-stirring groove 221, the liquid-feeding tube 2 can only rotate in one direction, so that the helical blade 242 and the liquid-stirring groove 221 can accurately play their roles. The rotation of the filling pipe 2 can be driven by a motor or manually. In consideration of the fact that in practical use, high rotating speed is not needed, and the direct rotation by hands is labor-consuming, the invention further designs a push type one-way driving mechanism.

As shown in fig. 1, 2 and 6, a spiral driving blade 25 is fixed on the outer wall of the liquid feeding tube 2, the one-way driving mechanism includes two driving plates 34 capable of cooperating with the spiral driving blade 25, and the two driving plates 34 can be controlled to separate or mutually abut through the separation and combination mechanism, as shown in fig. 8, when the two driving plates 34 abut against each other, they can cooperate to form a driving sleeve, the driving sleeve cooperates with the spiral direction of the spiral driving blade 25, which is a right-handed screw in this embodiment, when the driving sleeve moves towards the direction of the liquid separating head 22, the liquid feeding tube 2 can be rotated by the spiral driving blade 25, the spiral blade 242 is also a right-handed screw, and at this time, the pushing direction of the spiral blade 242 is just towards the liquid separating head 22.

In order to realize unidirectional driving, the invention is provided with a pressing rebound mechanism matched with the separating and combining mechanism, and the aim is to realize that the two driving sheets 34 are driven to mutually abut and the driving sheets 34 move towards the liquid separation head 22 during pressing, and the two driving sheets 34 are mutually separated and the driving sheets 34 move towards the sampling hopper 21 to reset during rebounding.

Specifically, the embodiment of the invention uses a press rebounding mechanism, which comprises a support 31 fixedly connected with the inner wall of the shell 1, the filling tube 2 can be rotatably matched with the support 31, so that the support 31 and the rotating seat 3 can form two rotating supports of the filling tube 2, two guide posts 311 parallel to the filling tube 2 are fixedly installed on the support 31, the same bearing plate 32 is slidably installed on the two guide posts 311, and a through hole 321 is formed in the center of the bearing plate 32, and the through hole 321 is used for allowing the filling tube 2 to pass through the bearing plate 32. A first spring 35 is arranged between the bearing plate 32 and the support 31, so that when the bearing plate 32 is pressed, the bearing plate 32 can move downwards, and when the bearing plate 32 is not pressed, the first spring 35 can reset the bearing plate 32.

A through groove 323 is formed in the bearing plate 32 on both sides of the through hole 321, a limiting post 331 is inserted into the through groove 323, the limiting post 331 can move up and down in the through groove 323, the top of the limiting post 331 is fixedly connected with the pressing plate 33, and the housing 1 is also provided with a pressing groove 11 matched with the pressing plate 33.

Correspondingly, the separating and combining mechanism comprises first wedge blocks 322 symmetrically arranged on the bearing plates 32 on two sides of the through hole 321, a cross rod 332 is fixedly connected between the two pressing plates 33, two second wedge blocks 333 are slidably mounted on the cross rod 332, the two second wedge blocks 333 are also symmetrically arranged on two sides of the through hole 321, and a second spring 334 is sleeved on the cross rod 332 between the two second wedge blocks 333. The two driving sheets 34 are respectively arranged on the opposite sides of the two wedge blocks 333, when the pressing plate 33 is pressed downwards, the relative distance between the pressing plate 33 and the bearing plate 32 is shortened, which is equivalent to that the two wedge blocks 333 move towards the two wedge blocks 322 respectively, because the wedge blocks 322 and the wedge blocks 333 are mutually matched wedges, the wedge block 322 is positioned on one side of the wedge blocks 333 far away from the liquid feeding pipe 2, when the wedge blocks 333 move towards the wedge blocks 322, the two wedge blocks 333 press the springs 334 and approach each other, so that the two driving sheets 34 are gradually mutually butted to form a driving sleeve in a matched mode.

As shown in fig. 7, the opposite sides of the two wedge-shaped blocks 333 are fixedly connected with a stopping plate 3331, when the two driving plates 34 are abutted against each other, the two stopping plates 3331 are also abutted against each other, and the stopping plate 3331 is used for preventing the driving plates 34 from being damaged due to excessive interference force.

The first spring 35 has higher deformation resistance than the second spring 334, that is, when the pressing plate 33 is pressed, the second spring 334 is deformed first, and then the first spring 35 is deformed. When the two driving tabs 34 have abutted against each other, the pressing plate 33 is further pressed, so that the loading plate 32 compresses the first spring 35 downward, and the driving sleeve moves toward the liquid separation head 22, cooperating with the helical driving blade 25 to drive the filling tube 2 to rotate. When the pressing plate 33 is released, the first spring 35 and the second spring 334 are reset, the reset of the second spring 334 enables the two driving sheets 34 to be separated so as to be disengaged from the spiral driving blade 25, and the reset of the first spring 35 enables the bearing plate 32 to be reset, so that the driving sheets 34 are carried to return to the original higher position. Through the arrangement, the liquid adding pipe 2 is driven to rotate in one direction, and the spiral blade 242 in the coating cylinder 24 can be ensured to rotate correctly to push the sample solution to the liquid separation head 22.

When in use: firstly, inserting the base 4 with the gene probe 42 from the bottom of the shell 1, enabling the top of the base 4 to abut against the lower surface of the limiting ring 12 to realize positioning, then adding a sample solution into the sample adding hopper 21, pressing the pressing plate 33, when the pressing plate 33 moves downwards, firstly, mutually abutting two driving sheets 34 to form a driving sleeve through the matching compression spring two 334 of the wedge-shaped block one 322 and the wedge-shaped block two 333, when the pressing plate continues to press downwards, the base plate starts to compress the spring one 35, the driving sleeve drives the spiral driving blade 25 to rotate, and further the liquid adding pipe 2 rotates, so that the sample solution flows from the liquid separating pipe 23 to the coating cylinder 24 under the action of centrifugal force, at the moment, the coating cylinder 24 rotates relative to the annular surface of the liquid separating pipe 23 under the influence of the friction 121, and the spiral blade 242 between the coating cylinder 24 and the liquid separating pipe 23 enables the sample solution to overcome the centrifugal force and move towards the liquid separating head 22, the sample solution is gradually discharged from the liquid outlet 241 while moving in the gap between the coating cylinder 24 and the liquid distribution tube 23, and is applied to the gene probe 42 by the coating cylinder 24. After the pressing plate 33 is loosened, the first spring 35 and the second spring 334 reset, the two driving sheets 34 return to the original height position under the condition of separation, the driving sheets 34 cannot drive the liquid feeding pipe 2 to rotate in the process, the liquid feeding pipe 2 is driven to rotate in one direction intermittently, the gene probe 42 is repeatedly smeared, the sample solution is enabled to be in full contact with the gene probe 42, and the condition that detection information is incomplete due to uneven coating is avoided.
